name: toast-stack
title: Toast Stack
description: Toasts that stack like a deck and fan out on hover so every message can be read.
docs:
import { ToastStack, useToastStack } from "@/components/toast-stack"

const { toasts, push, dismiss } = useToastStack()

<ToastStack toasts={toasts} onDismiss={dismiss} />
<button onClick={() => push({ title: "Saved", tone: "success" })}>Save</button>
